title: Vesper and the Harbor
author: Isandro Eastwick
blurb: Oscar Quintana, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must forgive the person in the mirror first before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
